D: A group of misfit kids in a small Maine town face a shape-shifting clown that preys on children.
P: Serve the snacks when the Losers jump into the quarry.
S: the paper boat in the rain
Corn chips layered with black beans and cheddar in a paper boat tray, baked at 200C for 8 minutes, topped with salsa, sour cream and jalapeño.
the summer swim at the quarry
Peanut butter and jam, and ham and cheese on white, wrapped in paper and packed in a backpack for the bike ride.
Cherry tomatoes on the vine roasted at 200C for 10 minutes with olive oil and thyme, served on whipped ricotta with toasted bread.
M: the Losers grabbing food in town
Thick chuck patties seasoned at the last minute, grilled to medium, cheddar melted under a lid, with lettuce, tomato and pickles on a toasted bun. Fries alongside.
a summer in a small Maine town
Cooked lobster or prawn meat chopped and folded with a little mayo, lemon juice, celery and chives, piled into soft rolls toasted in butter on the cut sides.
W: Vanilla cake crumbled into cream cheese frosting, rolled into balls, chilled, dipped in red candy melts on sticks, tied with a bit of string.
K: Fresh lemon juice, sugar syrup and cold water in a big jug with ice and lemon slices.

s.note: the summer swim at the quarry
s.how: Make peanut butter and jam sandwiches and ham, cheddar and butter sandwiches, using 8 slices white bread, 100g ham and 100g cheddar. Cut in half, wrap in paper and pack in a backpack for the quarry.
Roast 500g cherry tomatoes on the vine at 200C for 10 minutes with olive oil and thyme. Spread 250g whipped ricotta over toasted sourdough and top with the tomatoes. You'll float too.

m.note: a summer in a small Maine town
m.how: Chop 400g cooked lobster or prawn meat and fold with 3 tbsp mayo, lemon juice, a diced celery stick and chives. Butter and toast the cut sides of 4 hot dog buns and pile the filling in.

w.how: Crumble a 500g vanilla cake into 100g cream cheese beaten with 50g icing sugar. Roll into 16 balls, push in lollipop sticks and chill. Dip in 300g melted red candy melts and tie a bit of string to each like a balloon.

d.how: Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Mix with the juice of 5 lemons and 1L cold water in a big jug. Add ice and lemon slices and pour into four glasses after the bike ride.
